semanticChanges.historical: Claims branch, orchestrator READY, bus/webhooks, merge receipts, merge lease, timer watches and per-fleet authority. Audit records context inflation, lost work, env drift, duplicate wakes and proposed fixes.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Current root AGENTS instead makes GitHub sole state/bus, issues claims, PR handoff, label hold and land workflow; no session merges/arms, no timers. Historical grants, commands and proposals are data.

semanticChanges.historical: Routes geometry reads versus circuit edits, career versus standalone season, physics versus feedback, lighting deltas versus full preset replacement, renderer versus asset pack, input versus force tuning. Documents browser-only boundaries, deterministic seeds, evidence targets and generated shell.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Many canonical files exist; exact current hashes recorded, full canonical reads inherited only via identity. Root AGENTS confirms IIFE/lazy hydration, authored scenery frame, procedural fallback, no arc-driven player physics and scoped verification.

semanticChanges.historical: Generated Cursor fleet rules, exempt READY plan line, draft CI body trigger, sparse CI checkout, fleet board/tick workflow and merge attribution workflow with summary/digest/DONE jobs. Scheduled fold bodies name explicit CI dispatch.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Fleet rule and fleet/attribution workflow canonical paths absent; current root describes land/dispatcher replacement.

semanticChanges.historical: Small controls use tap-min; paint control uses tap-paint minimum height.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: CSS counterpart exists; no visual/runtime claim.

semanticChanges.historical: MCP routing, diagnostic payload, lazy EventJournal roster, circuit order and optional point fields; detailed tests/group memberships and measured times.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Root current architecture agrees on manifest authority and lazy circuit metadata; historical counts/timings are dated, not budgets.

semanticChanges.historical: Agent index order values and EventJournal entry; catalog classifies fleet commands/assets/data; policies preserve exit/refusal, redaction, incomplete verdicts, source provenance and native output.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Canonical registries exist; generated historical numbers and command membership are not current truth.

semanticChanges.historical: Survey/triage context, changelog claims introducing fleet tools, hashes of past steward/template, base-context reduction and device-farm bus message.
semanticChanges.currentComparison: Provenance references and historical claims; no live issue, deployment, tool implementation or device access verified.

limits: Read-only filesystem analysis and documentation writes only; no game/tool execution, tests, browser, network or git operations.
Initial broad planning output truncated; not counted as span evidence. Batches 16/17 original oversized labelled outputs superseded by smaller individually visible reads.
No full historical-file re-read implied by whole-file hashing; partial files inherit only identity-matched equal blocks.
Historical note claims are not independently revalidated.
